say:1:1721702001:1.text: Gwyneth, I'm sorry I couldn't make it... Something urgent came up, and I couldn't get away.
say:1:1721702001:1.source_cn: 格温妮丝，关于今天……我很抱歉。临时有紧急公务绊住了脚...

say:2:1721702002:1.text: No worries, Commander. Duty comes first. I trust you have your reasons, just as you do for keeping me off the investigation.
say:2:1721702002:1.source_cn: 没关系，司令。身为军人，任务优先。我能理解您的苦衷，就...

say:3:1721702003:1.text: I know you're upset. To make it up to you, I'll grant any request you have, except for joining the investigation.
say:3:1721702003:1.source_cn: 我知道你在生气。作为补偿，除了让你涉险去调查圣古堂消失...

say:4:1721702004:1.text: Really? Very well. Please issue an immediate order to seal and search the <style="highlight">Silken Snare</style>, as well as detain its proprietor, Voracia.
say:4:1721702004:1.source_cn: 真的吗？那好。既然您不让我调查，那就请您立刻下令——封...

say:5:1721702005:2.text: Why? Did something happen while you were there?
say:5:1721702005:2.source_cn: 什么，查封丝绒陷阱？今天发生什么事了吗？

say:6:1721702006:2.text: I... slipped into the kitchen... and found some illegal ingredients...
say:6:1721702006:2.source_cn: 我……我潜入了那里的后厨……看到了一些违禁的食材……

say:8:1721702008:1.text: Gwyneth, you're a Royal Guard captain, not a petty criminal! What you did amounts to trespassing!
say:8:1721702008:1.source_cn: 格温妮丝！你是守备军的队长，不是市井的小偷。未经许可擅...

say:9:1721702009:1.text: ... Also, Magister Merlin and I have found a possible connection between Voracia and the Hall of Ancients' disappearance.
say:9:1721702009:1.source_cn: ……还有一件事，梅林阁下和我已经推断出——圣古堂的消失...
say:9:1721702009:1.male: ... Also, Magister Merlin and I have found a possible connection between Voracia and the Hall of Ancients' disappearance.
say:9:1721702009:1.female: ... Also, Magister Merlin and I have found a possible connection between Voracia and the Hall of Ancients' disappearance.

say:10:1721702010:3.text: Gwyneth explains to Hendrik the similar mechanism behind how dishes are served at Silken Snare and how the Hall of Ancients vanished, as well as the leads found by Merlin.
say:10:1721702010:3.source_cn: 格温妮丝向亨德里克仔细解释了传菜和传送圣古堂之间相似的...
say:10:1721702010:3.male: Gwyneth explains to Hendrik the similar mechanism behind how dishes are served at Silken Snare and how the Hall of Ancients vanished, as well as the leads found by Merlin.
say:10:1721702010:3.female: Gwyneth explains to Hendrik the similar mechanism behind how dishes are served at Silken Snare and how the Hall of Ancients vanished, as well as the leads found by Merlin.

say:11:1721702011:1.text: D-Does this conclusion come from Magister Merlin himself?
say:11:1721702011:1.source_cn: 这……这是梅林阁下确定的判断吗？
say:11:1721702011:1.male: D-Does this conclusion come from Magister Merlin himself?
say:11:1721702011:1.female: D-Does this conclusion come from Magister Merlin herself?

say:12:1721702012:1.text: Yes. While we have yet to determine Voracia's motive or identify the person behind her, all the leads we have so far point to her.
say:12:1721702012:1.source_cn: 千真万确。虽然我们还没查清她的动机和背后的主使，但现在...

say:13:1721702013:1.text: Father, please issue the order immediately! We can't afford any delay!
say:13:1721702013:1.source_cn: 父亲，下令吧！我们没有时间犹豫了！

say:16:1721702016:1.text: Without a search warrant, any evidence you've found is legally inadmissible.
say:16:1721702016:1.source_cn: 没有搜查令，没有正当程序，你们所看到的罪证在法律上是无效的。

say:17:1721702017:1.text: If we act hastily, Voracia could just say you planted the evidence and even file a counterclaim for abuse of power!
say:17:1721702017:1.source_cn: 如果我们现在冲过去，对方完全可以说是你栽赃陷害，甚至可...

say:19:1721702019:1.text: Now, I need to attend to something urgent. Don't think you're off the hook—we'll settle this later.
say:19:1721702019:1.source_cn: 我先临时去处理一个紧急公务。你擅闯民宅的事情，我之后再...

say:20:1721702020:1.text: Stay here and think about what you've done!
say:20:1721702020:1.source_cn: 现在，你给我老老实实待在驻地里反省，哪里也不许去！

say:21:1721702021:1.text: Where are you going? Now that we've identified the suspect—
say:21:1721702021:1.source_cn: 您要去哪？既然知道了嫌疑人——

say:22:1721702022:1.text: Stay here! This is an order!
say:22:1721702022:1.source_cn: 待在守备军驻地！这是命令！

say:24:1721702023:1.text: Without another word, Hendrik hurries out of the base.
say:24:1721702023:1.source_cn: 亨德里克没有再多做解释，就那样神色匆匆地离开了驻地。

say:25:1721702024:1.text: Gwyneth's suspicions deepen as she watches her father leave.
say:25:1721702024:1.source_cn: 格温妮丝看着那个迅速出行的背影，心中的疑云不仅没有消散...

say:26:1721702025:1.text: Something's not right. Father seemed like... he already expected what I found.
say:26:1721702025:1.source_cn: 太不对劲了，父亲的反应不仅仅是惊讶，更像是……知情者。

say:27:1721702026:1.text: No urgent reports came in today, and Father didn't bring anyone along. And the direction he was heading...
say:27:1721702026:1.source_cn: 没人报告临时的公务，父亲也没有带上副官及其他守备军，而...

say:28:1721702027:0.text: Since you're determined to hide the truth from me, I'll find out for myself.
say:28:1721702027:0.source_cn: 父亲，既然您不肯告诉我真相，那我就自己去看。

say:30:1721703001:0.text: Father's always been vigilant. I'd better not get too close.
say:30:1721703001:0.source_cn: 父亲小心谨慎，我得注意跟着的距离。
